items.title: As Nike (NKE) Craters to New Lows, Insiders Are Buying This Rival On The Dip
items.summary: Nike (NYSE:NKE) shares recently fell to new lows in about 12 years amid rising competition and falling sales. Despite the plunge, the stock’s forward P/E still sits at 23.38, a 46% premium to the sector median of 15.99. There is another, smaller competitor that is gaining attention.
